grammar_focus: 综合复习课:把前面学过的难点放在一起复习——happen to / it happened that(碰巧)、否定词句首倒装(Not only had he… / Never had…)、否定前缀(im-/ir-/dis-/un-/in-/il-)、be supposed to(本应)、would rather + 某人 + 过去式、had better、save up、find sb to be(原创承载 NCE3 L20 复习课·无需净化·1909年飞越英吉利海峡的竞赛:拉塔姆两次落海,布莱里奥37分钟成功横渡)
scene: 1908年,一位富有的报业主悬赏一千英镑,奖给第一个飞越英吉利海峡的飞行员——那是横在英法之间的一道狭窄海面。一年多过去,才有人敢试。1909年7月19日清早,法国人于贝尔·拉塔姆驾着他的飞机“安托瓦内特”号从法国海岸起飞。他只飞了七英里,发动机突然熄火,被迫降落在海面上。飞机静静浮着,直到一艘过路的船把他救起。拉塔姆不肯轻易罢休。几天后,对手路易·布莱里奥也带着自己的小飞机来到海岸附近。布莱里奥从1905年起就一直在造飞机,这是他最新的一架。两人本应在7月25日一同起飞,看上去会有一场精彩的比赛。可那天早上,拉塔姆偏偏没能早早醒来。布莱里奥在黎明前做了一次短暂试飞,随后出发。他那次著名的飞行只用了三十七分钟。降落在多佛附近时,第一个迎接他的,是一名一脸惊讶的当地警察。布莱里奥不但赢得了奖金,还创造了历史——成为第一个驾机飞越海峡的人。

grammar_card.title: 综合复习:倒装 / 否定前缀 / be supposed to / had better
grammar_card.intro: 本课把前面几单元的难点串起来复习:①happen to do / It happened that…（碰巧）。②否定词(Not only / Never / Not until)放句首,主句要倒装,把 had / did 提到主语前面:Not only had he won…。③加否定前缀构成反义词:im-（impolite）、ir-（irregular）、dis-（disagree）、un-（unlocked）、in-（inaccurate）、il-（illegible）。④be supposed to（本应、理应）。⑤would rather + 某人 + 过去式(委婉愿望)。⑥had better（最好)、save up（攒钱)、find sb to be（发现某人是…）。

rows: Latham happened to be over the sea.
Not only had he won the prize…
were supposed to fly / had better check

specialRules.rule: 否定词(Not only / Never / Not until)放句首时,主句要倒装:把 had 或 did 提到主语前面(Not only had he… / Not until noon did he…)。
不同的词用不同的否定前缀,要一个个记:im-（p/m 前)、ir-（r 前)、il-（l 前)、in-、un-、dis-。
美式用词:airplane(英式 aeroplane)、gasoline/gas(英式 petrol)。本课已按美语写。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What was the name of the first plane to fly across the English Channel?

passage: In 1908, a wealthy newspaper owner offered a prize of a thousand pounds to the first pilot who would fly across the English Channel, the narrow stretch of sea between England and France. More than a year passed before anyone dared to try. Early on the morning of July 19th, 1909, a Frenchman named Hubert Latham took off from the French coast in his plane, the 'Antoinette.' He had flown only seven miles when his engine suddenly failed, and he was forced to land on the water. The plane floated calmly until a passing ship picked him up. Latham did not give up easily. A few days later a rival, Louis Blériot, arrived near the coast with a small plane of his own. Blériot had been building airplanes since 1905, and this was his newest model. Both men were supposed to take off on July 25th, and it looked as if there would be an exciting race. That morning, however, Latham failed to wake up early enough. Blériot made a short test flight before dawn, then set off. His famous flight lasted only thirty-seven minutes. When he landed near Dover, the first person to greet him was a surprised local policeman. Not only had Blériot won the prize, but he had also made history as the first pilot ever to fly a plane across the Channel.

复习:had better / save up / find sb to be

stage5.stem: "Latham ___ to be flying over the sea when his engine failed."(“碰巧正在”)
stage5.stem_cn: 拉塔姆发动机出故障时,碰巧正飞在海面上。

stage5.stem: "It ___ that both pilots reached the coast on the same day."(It ___ that… “碰巧”)
stage5.stem_cn: 碰巧两位飞行员同一天到了海岸。

stage5.stem: "If you ___ to see Blériot's plane, you'd find it very small."(与 if 连用,表“万一/碰巧”,用原形)
stage5.stem_cn: 你要是碰巧见到布莱里奥的飞机,会发现它很小。

stage5.stem: "Not only ___ Blériot won the prize, but he also made history."(否定词句首,主句倒装)
stage5.stem_cn: 布莱里奥不但赢了奖,还创造了历史。

stage5.stem: "Never ___ a plane crossed the Channel before that day."(Never 句首,倒装)
stage5.stem_cn: 那天之前,从没有飞机飞越过海峡。

stage5.stem: "Not until noon ___ Latham realize he had overslept."(Not until 句首,倒装)
stage5.stem_cn: 直到中午,拉塔姆才意识到自己睡过了头。

stage5.stem: "The opposite of 'polite' is ___."(用哪个否定前缀)
"The opposite of 'regular' is ___."(用哪个否定前缀)
"The opposite of 'agree' is ___."(用哪个否定前缀)
"Both pilots ___ to take off on July 25th."(be supposed to:“本应”)
stage5.stem_cn: 两位飞行员本应在7月25日起飞。

stage5.stem: "You are ___ to arrive before dawn, not after."(表“本应、理应”的固定说法)
stage5.stem_cn: 你本应在黎明前到,而不是之后。

stage5.stem: "The judge would rather Latham ___ up earlier that morning."(would rather + 某人 + 过去式)
stage5.stem_cn: 裁判宁愿拉塔姆那天早上早点醒。

stage5.stem: "You ___ check the engine before you take off."(“最好”忠告)
stage5.stem_cn: 起飞前你最好检查一下发动机。

stage5.stem: "If Blériot could ___ enough money, he would build a better plane."(短语动词“攒钱”)
stage5.stem_cn: 布莱里奥要是能攒够钱,就会造更好的飞机。

stage5.stem: "Reporters found Blériot ___ a modest, quiet man."(find sb 后接不定式)
stage5.stem_cn: 记者们发现布莱里奥是个谦逊安静的人。

stage5.stem: "A person who is among the first to do something new is a ___."(“先驱”用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 最早去做某件新事的人是先驱。

stage5.stem: "Traveling across land, not over water or air, is ___ travel."(“陆上的”用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 走陆路而非水路或空路的旅行。

stage5.stem: "To welcome someone when they arrive is to ___ them."(“迎接”用哪个词)
